content: better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers (npm) is a drop-in fork of better-sqlite3 adding SQLite3MultipleCiphers support (AES-256, ChaCha20, SQLCipher-compatible schemes) and is actively maintained (frequent releases, real-world adoption, ~50+ dependents). It is the practical way to get an encrypted SQLite file with a synchronous Node.js API without hand-rolling per-field encryption, and it is Electron-prebuild compatible, which matters for a later desktop path.
